REST.top: Come unto me, all ye that labour
REST.bot: and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
REST.gkm: To give rest; to refresh; to cause to cease.
REST.hbm: To cease; to stop; to rest; to dwell.

HOPE.bot: for I shall yet praise him...
HOPE.hbm: Hope, expectation, a cord of hope.

LOVE.top: This is my commandment, That ye
LOVE.bot: love one another, as I have loved you.
LOVE.hbm: Love, affection; to love, to befriend.

TRUST.top: Commit thy way unto the LORD;
TRUST.bot: trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
TRUST.gkm: To trust, to be confident, persuaded.
TRUST.hbm: To trust, to be secure, to feel safe.

PRAY.top: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say,
PRAY.bot: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

BELIEVE.top: Let not your heart be troubled.
BELIEVE.bot: Believe in God, believe also in me.
BELIEVE.gkm: To believe, trust, to have faith in.
BELIEVE.hbm: To confirm, support; to be firm, faithful.

FORGIVE.top: For if ye forgive men their trespasses,
FORGIVE.bot: your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
FORGIVE.gkm: To forgive, release, to let go, send away.

GIVE.top: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure,
GIVE.bot: pressed down, and shaken together, and running over...
GIVE.hbm: To give, put, to set, bestow.

SEEK.top: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness;
SEEK.bot: and all these things shall be added unto you.
SEEK.gkm: To seek, to search, to strive for.
SEEK.hbm: To seek, inquire, to search out.

ASK.top: ...how much more shall your heavenly Father
ASK.bot: give the Holy Spirit to them that ask Him?
ASK.gkm: To ask, request, to call for.

KNOCK.top: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek and ye shall find;
KNOCK.bot: knock and it shall be opened unto you.
KNOCK.gkm: To knock, to rap at a door.
KNOCK.hbm: To knock, to beat, to rap.

FOLLOW.top: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself,
FOLLOW.bot: and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
FOLLOW.gkm: To follow, accompany, to go with.
FOLLOW.hbm: To walk, to go, to follow after.

LISTEN.top: But whoever listens to me will dwell safely,
LISTEN.bot: And will be secure, without fear of evil.
LISTEN.gkm: To hear, to listen, to heed.
LISTEN.hbm: To hear, to listen, to obey.

REMEMBER.top: This is my body which is given for you:
REMEMBER.bot: this do in remembrance of me.
REMEMBER.gkm: To remember, to keep in mind.
REMEMBER.hbm: To remember, recall, to be mindful.

CHOOSE.top: I have set before you life and death,
CHOOSE.bot: blessing and cursing: therefore choose life...
CHOOSE.gkm: To choose, select, to pick out.

HONOR.bot: which is the first commandment with a promise.
HONOR.gkm: To honor, value, to esteem, prize.
HONOR.hbm: To honor, glorify; to be weighty.

GROW.top: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge
GROW.bot: of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
GROW.hbm: To grow, become great, to magnify.

GATHER.top: For where two or three are gathered
GATHER.bot: in my name, there I am in the midst of them.

ACCEPT.top: Therefore, accept one another, just as Christ
ACCEPT.bot: also accepted us, for the glory of God.
ACCEPT.hbm: To be pleased with, to accept, delight in.

BREATHE.top: Come from the four winds, O breath,
BREATHE.bot: and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
BREATHE.gkm: To breathe upon, to breathe into.
BREATHE.hbm: Breath, breath of life; the spirit of life.

ENJOY.top: And also that every man should eat and drink, and
ENJOY.bot: enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
ENJOY.gkm: To enjoy, to benefit, to take pleasure.
ENJOY.hbm: To rejoice, be glad, to take delight.

LIVE.top: I shall not die, but live,
LIVE.bot: And declare the works of the LORD.
LIVE.hbm: To live, to revive, to be alive.

SING.top: Sing unto Him a new song;
SING.bot: Play skilfully with a loud noise.

LAUGH.top: A time to weep, and a time to laugh;
LAUGH.bot: a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
LAUGH.hbm: To laugh, to rejoice, to play.
